_comment: Declared invariants for a stamped <field>-lit instance, read by
scripts/check_drift.py.  Values marked null are filled by the tier that
produces them; built_tiers records progress and gates the checker's
sections.  Every number carries a sibling _why once filled -- the parent
_why_built_tiers: appended by the factory at each tier acceptance: 0=corpus, 1=style layer, 2=chapter map (lives in the draft instance), 4=exemplars

corpus._why: the four denominators from corpus_meta.yaml -- 'files' counts duplicates and damaged extractions; quote the right one for the question (term verdicts use terminology_safe, style norms use style_safe)

thresholds._why_attested_min_papers: corpus-linguistics floor: a phrase carried by three independent author teams is no longer one author's habit; identical constant in attest.py and measure_register.py, agreement asserted by check_drift

transitions._why: filled from build_transitions.py output at Tier 1

cohesion._why: filled from build_cohesion_norms.py output at Tier 1; fine per-section cells arrive only after Tier 2 slices exist

exemplars._why: filled at Tier 4 from the tagging passes (build_exemplars.py prints the counts); move_tags = the 8-label vocabulary from prompts/exemplar-tagging.md, asserted both ways by check_drift; meta_headings = non-paper ## headings in exemplars.md; watch for BOM at section boundaries (the parent's 159-counted-as-158 lesson)
